subject.title: WhatsApp: support pre-built link previews in sendMessage + batch send RPC method

question: Should OpenClaw accept this as one combined WhatsApp/Gateway feature, split it into narrower preview pass-through and batch-send design items, or defer the public batch RPC?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the request spans a channel plugin payload surface, a security-sensitive preview-fetch setting, and a public Gateway protocol shape, so automation cannot choose the product/API boundary safely.

options.title: Split Preview From Batch
options.body: Accept a narrow WhatsApp pre-built preview pass-through design first, and require a separate maintainer-approved security/protocol design for automatic preview fetching and public batch send.

options.title: Implement Combined Feature
options.body: Treat this issue as the canonical umbrella for pass-through preview metadata, opt-in preview fetching, and batch Gateway send, with full security and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Defer Public Batch RPC
options.body: Keep WhatsApp preview work open but route bulk/digest sending to channel-specific automation or a later Gateway protocol proposal.

recommendation.title: Split Preview From Batch
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow WhatsApp pre-built preview pass-through design first, and require a separate maintainer-approved security/protocol design for automatic preview fetching and public batch send.

likelyOwner.reason: He previously handled the canonical link-preview consolidation and was tied to the reverted pass-through merge, making him the best available owner for the product/API decision.
